question: On fresh r58, how much do local land-water recycling and the missing monsoon wind turning contribute to the large Somali rain error, separately and together? Does their apparent benefit also dry a desert control?
reason: Fresh97-region inventory identifies s_2n_43e (Somalia) as the largest loss burden, annual rain7.78 times observed. The r52 diagnostic found heat lows outside the regional domain suppress e55 turning; e109 globally failed. Do not repeat a global floor search or presume local evaporation is the dominant cause without a current ablation.
baseline: Exact adopted r58 parameters and fresh paired reference qualified in output/climate_runtime_20261126/qualification.json. No physical model or shared-cache modification while W18c runs.
source_scope: Only these two already-spent development regions from sealed_S18 and sealed_U18. No new region pool, boundary/domain change or unopened AA observation. Same56km cells and1100km pad.
budget: Eight regional integrations total, including two exact baseline controls, under this fixed two-by-two factorial. No parameter fit, extra point, range search or best-variant adoption. Global counterfactuals are diagnostic interventions, not proposed climates.
measurements: Monthly observed/simulated rain, production-calendar-integrated evaporation, column water, surface u/v and temperature error, annual rain ratio, existing rainfall loss and strict numerical certificate. Production monthly_stats uses12 equal-length model months, not Gregorian month lengths; preserve this convention. Label surface winds; do not conflate with a separately modeled transport wind. Save fields and provenance. Report months3/5/7/10 and all12 months in tables, without selecting only favourable seasons.
interpretation: Ablations establish responses within this model, not observed causal contributions or resource budgets. The coupled wind/temperature/moisture/soil solution may change. Rain minus evaporation is not itself an audited advective flux; no moisture-closure claim without boundary flux accounting. Compare full factorial interaction and region-specific failures. Sahara ratio is unstable under very small observed rain: retain absolute rain and rainfall loss.
checks: Plan committed before running. Both control case identities and Ts/Ps/To/Po arrays must exactly match the fresh reference; all eight runs require strict numerical checks. Source/parameter/cache identities pinned and unchanged through completion. Monthly rain uses the production monthly_stats integration, not a30.4-day approximation. No statistical validation or main atlas change.
W18c_independence: No change to its parameters, budget, finalist objective or gates; no fine/sealed data used here. Run sequentially in one diagnostic process to limit resource competition. Results inform the next separately declared structural experiment after W18c closes.
